description: 1st connection. Official lesson-level manifest for 08-02 (distinct from the part08-02-makei-probe/2/3 investigation manifests, which already confirmed makei build mechanics in the disposable &LIB2 library via python3-binary-written Rules.mk/iproj.json - not via git). This manifest closes the one gap those probes left open (advisor review, 2026-09-29): no probe had ever run makei build against files that arrived via git (the same delivery path 08-01 teaches learners to use), and templates/part08-zaisrv/ had no .gitattributes of its own after the templates/part08-project/ split, so a learner whose git config does not already normalize line endings could in principle commit a CRLF Rules.mk. This connection (a) deliberately writes Rules.mk with CRLF before the first commit, to actually exercise the newly-added templates/part08-zaisrv/.gitattributes' `* text=auto eol=lf` line (not just infer it works by analogy to 08-01's already-LF CPYTOSTMF output), (b) reuses 08-01's own proven bare-repo/PC-repo-stand-in/push/clone pattern so the git round trip itself is the same mechanism 08-01 already established, and (c) targets the real &LIB (the learner's own Part 7 dev library, where the traditionally-built ZAISRV already exists) instead of the disposable &LIB2, so the 'makei rebuilds a pre-existing non-makei object' scenario is confirmed for real, not just in a throwaway library. Also repeats the add-a-PF exercise end to end in this same project layout, matching part08-02-testpf's already-confirmed recipe.

steps.label: PCREPO
steps.cmd:
mkdir -p "$HOME/mk10/p" && cd "$HOME/mk10/p" && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git init -b main 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git config user.name 'Learner (verify harness rehearsal)' 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git config user.email 'learner-rehearsal-no-email' 2>&1
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/python3 -c "open('$HOME/mk10/p/iproj.json','wb').write(b'{"version":"0.0.1","objlib":"&LIB","curlib":"&LIB"}')"
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/python3 -c "open('$HOME/mk10/p/Rules.mk','wb').write(b'ZAISRV.MODULE: zaisrv.rpgle
ZAISRV.SRVPGM: ZAISRV.MODULE zaisrv.bnd
')"
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/python3 -c "open('$HOME/mk10/p/.gitattributes','wb').write(b'* text=auto eol=lf
*.rpg text eol=lf
*.rpgle text eol=lf
*.clp text eol=lf
*.clle text eol=lf
*.pf text eol=lf
*.lf text eol=lf
*.dspf text eol=lf
*.prtf text eol=lf
*.cmd text eol=lf
*.rpgleinc text eol=lf
*.bnd text eol=lf
*.sql text eol=lf
*.sqlrpgle text eol=lf
*.md text eol=lf
*.json text eol=lf
')"
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QRPGLESRC.FILE/ZAISRV.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk10/p/zaisrv.rpgle') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QSRVSRC.FILE/ZAISRV.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk10/p/zaisrv.bnd') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
echo ---PRECOMMIT-RULES-MK-BYTES---
od -c "$HOME/mk10/p/Rules.mk" </dev/null 2>&1 | head -3
cd "$HOME/mk10/p" && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git add -A 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git commit -m 'initial import: ZAISRV makei project (Rules.mk deliberately CRLF, to test .gitattributes normalization)' 2>&1

steps.label: PUSH
steps.cmd: cd "$HOME/mk10/p" && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git remote add origin "$HOME/mk10/b.git" 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git --no-pager push origin main 2>&1

steps.label: CLONE
steps.cmd:
cd "$HOME/mk10" && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git clone b.git c 2>&1
echo ---CLONE-RULES-MK-BYTES---
od -c "$HOME/mk10/c/Rules.mk" </dev/null 2>&1 | head -3
echo ---CLONE-IPROJ-JSON---
cat "$HOME/mk10/c/iproj.json" </dev/null 2>&1
echo
echo ---CLONE-TREE---
find "$HOME/mk10/c" -maxdepth 1 -type f </dev/null 2>&1

steps.label: ADDPF
steps.cmd:
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QDDSSRC.FILE/TESTPF.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk10/c/testpf.pf') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/python3 -c "open('$HOME/mk10/c/Rules.mk','ab').write(b'TESTPF.FILE: testpf.pf\n')"
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/bash -c 'cd "$HOME/mk10/c" && export PATH=/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin:$PATH && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/makei build' </dev/null 2>&1

steps.sql: SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJLIB, OBJCREATED, LAST_USED_TIMESTAMP FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB', 'ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME = 'ZAISRV' ORDER BY OBJTYPE
